query: INSERT INTO oauth_connections (public_id, user_id, client_id, return_host, scopes, created_at, updated_at) SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $7, $7 WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM oauth_connections WHERE user_id = $2) < $6 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oauth_connections WHERE user_id = $2 AND client_id = $3) ON CONFLICT (user_id, client_id) DO UPDATE SET scopes = EXCLUDED.scopes, return_host = EXCLUDED.return_host, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at RETURNING id, public_id
